stem.text: What explains why monoclonal antibodies can be used to target cancer cells?

A.text: Cancer cells have different antigens from normal body cells.

B.text: Specific cancer drugs can be attached to the monoclonal antibody.

C.text: They are one type of a specific antibody that binds to an antigen.

D.text: They are secreted by hybridomas of cancer cells and B-lymphocytes.
